description: This file contains the PHP class definition for 'Filter', an admin controller extension in the OpenCart platform, responsible for managing filter modules within the admin interface.

classes.name: Filter
classes.description: Controller class for managing filter modules within the OpenCart admin extension, extending the base Controller class. Provides methods for rendering the filter module configuration page ('index') and saving configuration settings ('save').

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the filter module configuration page, sets page title, breadcrumbs, loads necessary controllers for header, footer, and column content, and passes data to the view template.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles POST request to save the filter module settings, verifying user permissions, updating settings via the setting model, and returning a JSON response indicating success or errors.
